title: Space rocks
info: An asteroid is a rocky leftover, often found between Mars and Jupiter.
A comet is ice and dust. Near the Sun it can grow a tail that points away from the Sun.
A meteor is a streak of light in the air. A meteorite is a rock that reaches the ground.

options: a streak of light in the sky
